references.text: The Philistines had dominion over Israel, which explains why Judah's men were afraid of the Philistines' reaction.
The background to why the Philistines came up against Judah, and why Judah's men wanted to hand Samson over.
Samson gives the same kind of justification for his actions - that he only repaid what they did to him.
Israel under Philistine dominion, a similar situation where the Israelites lived under Philistine oppression.
The principle of retribution - an eye for an eye - which Samson invokes when he says he only repaid what the Philistines did to him.
The law's principle of retribution that Samson refers to in his justification.
Paul urges not to take revenge oneself, in contrast to Samson's self-justification of his retaliation.
